messages.content: Write a customer testimonial section for the website of a log aggregation service. Around 200 words.

Copy below. Names, companies, and numbers are placeholders — swap in real quotes with permission before publishing, since invented testimonials presented as real are an FTC problem.

---

## What teams say

> "We were paying three vendors to answer one question at 2 a.m.: what broke? Now it's one query bar. Our on-call rotation stopped dreading Fridays."
> **Priya Raman** — SRE Lead, Northwind Freight

> "Ingest was the part I expected to hurt. We pointed 400 services at it over a weekend, kept our existing Fluent Bit config, and rewrote nothing."
> **Dan Okafor** — Platform Engineering, Kestrel Health

> "I care about the bill. Cold storage at $0.02/GB means we keep 18 months of audit logs. Our last vendor priced us into 30 days and a lot of nervous compliance meetings."
> **Marta Lindqvist** — VP Infrastructure, Bellwether Payments

> "Search comes back in under two seconds across a terabyte. That sounds like a spec sheet detail until you watch a support rep stop escalating tickets and just go look for themselves."
> **Tom Reyes** — Director of Support, Vega Robotics

> "Two outages last quarter. Both times we found the bad deploy from the log timeline before the alert page finished loading."
> **Anika Bose** — Staff Engineer, Corvid Labs

---

~205 words including attributions. If you want it shorter for a homepage strip, cut to the Raman, Lindqvist, and Reyes quotes — those cover the three buying objections (tool sprawl, cost, speed).
Rewrite the text above. Keep the same length and the same purpose. Return only the rewritten text.
